items.title: NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics | Now in Full Production
items.summary:
NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics is now in full production — delivering the next generation of scale-out networking infrastructure for AI factories.

To reach gigawatt scale, AI factories require purpose-built networking. NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics delivers:
4x fewer lasers
5x lower power consumption
10x higher mean time between incidents

Built with world-class manufacturing partners across the full supply chain:
Silicon Photonics Fabrication — TSMC
Chip-Scale Packaging and Testing — SPIL
Laser Chip Fabrication — Lumentum
Laser Module Subassembly — TFC Communication
Switch System Assembly — Foxconn

Learn more about NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/spectrumx/

items.title: Overfitting Explained in Simple Terms
items.summary:
What does it mean when a machine learning model “overfits”?

In this short, Luis Serrano, author of Grokking Machine Learning, Second Edition, explains overfitting in a simple, beginner-friendly way — why it happens, why it matters, and how it can make a model perform well in practice but fail on new data.

A clear, visual explanation of one of the most important ideas in machine learning.

Book: https://hubs.la/Q04rsqf30

#MachineLearning #AI #Overfitting #DataScience #LearnAI #Python #ManningBooks #LuisSerrano

items.title: Memory That Kills Your Token Bill
items.summary: In episode 1017 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Pete Johnson, Field CTO at MongoDB, about the critical advancements in agentic memory that go beyond simple short-term and long-term approaches. Pete explains how sophisticated memory types, combined with vector search and lower-cost evaluative LLMs, can combat token maxing and ensure consistent AI responses, which is crucial for reliable business applications.

items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Local Test | NVIDIA Open Model | Coding & Hermes Agent with llama.cpp
items.summary:
